::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Feb 27 1868  
**Manuscript:** Copy outletter book British Library Add MSS.55388 (1): P. 62
:::

Dear Miss Yonge,

How do you like the enclosed title page? If it suits your idea I am well pleased with it.[^1]

Yours very faithfully
[A. Macmillan](people/person_939.qmd)

---

[^1]: Probably that for *Historical Selections*.
